name: emudhra-trust-audit
description: Unofficial, read-only audit skills for the 2026 eMudhra weak intermediate CA key incident: check this computer's trust stores and a repository's CA bundles, TLS settings and dependency versions using only OS-standard commands.

interface.shortDescription: Audit trust in eMudhra CA keys
interface.longDescription: Unofficial community skills, not affiliated with eMudhra. Read-only checks of this computer's CA stores and of a repository's CA bundles, TLS-bypass settings and dependency versions against the compromised eMudhra intermediate SPKI hashes, using only OS-standard commands. Reports evidence, confidence and coverage gaps; never changes anything or sends data.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer still trusts the compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys
Audit this repository for the eMudhra CA incident and TLS verification bypasses
